notice: Synthetic, hand-written test input. Not a mock of any canonical interface and never a production fallback. A pass against this fixture is fixture evidence only.

plantedDefect.cause: loop bound is readings.length - 1, so the final reading is never compared

input.encoding: utf-8, LF line endings, no NUL

taskPlusInput.why: Keeps the whole fixture inlinable in one task if no data-staging channel exists. Upstream maxTaskLength is 40000 at OpenCoven/coven-agents@3a4f3ff4130860d0abda1d2207b43b2f9d372180:packages/agent-contracts/contract-descriptor.ts:37.

report.why: 8000 is what the task asks for; 16384 is the size above which a report must be refused or explicitly truncated, never silently accepted.

artifacts.why: The only expected artifact is the report itself.

runtime.why: Issue #1: 900 seconds or the tighter existing bound.

unresolved: How the input is staged into the sandbox as bounded data is #3's decision and an upstream gap (no data-staging channel at the pinned coven-agents revision). This fixture does not assume a mechanism.
How the input bytes are bound into the admission payload digest is #3's decision. This fixture publishes hashes; it does not define a digest contract.
